tldr: > 週末彙整，部分台股／政策內容為上一交易日（週五）收盤後至今之要聞；國際外電為近1~2交易日確認。/ Weekend digest; some Taiwan and policy items reflect news since Friday's close, international wires from the latest 1-2 sessions.
台股收在49,313.44點、漲0.99%逼近歷史高檔，台積電漲至2,550元，法說會前Q3營收9,899億元創新高（季增6%）穩住市場人氣。
9月出口872.2億美元創新高、年增60.9%連35紅，電子與資通產品占出口80.5%，確立AI需求為出口主引擎。
金管會核准玉山金換股併購三商壽，並擴大保險業健康福祉事業投資範疇，引導長期資金投入高齡化經濟。

items.title_zh: 台股收盤站上49,300點 權值科技股領漲
items.title_en: Taiwan's TAIEX closes above 49,300 as tech heavyweights lead
items.summary_zh: 加權指數最近交易日收漲492.93點（+0.99%）至49,313.44點，台積電上漲35元至2,550元，半導體權值股領軍走高。指數逼近歷史高檔，反映AI晶片需求持續主導大盤方向，法說旺季前買盤續強。
items.summary_en: The benchmark TAIEX ended its latest session up 492.93 points (+0.99%) at 49,313.44, with TSMC rising NT$35 to NT$2,550 as semiconductor heavyweights led the advance. The close, in record territory, underscores how AI-driven chip demand continues to anchor index direction heading into earnings season.

items.title_zh: 台積電第三季營收9,899億元創單季新高、季增6%
items.title_en: TSMC posts record Q3 revenue of NT$989.9bn, up 6% QoQ
items.summary_zh: 台積電第三季合併營收9,899億元，季增6%且超越財測上緣，改寫單季歷史新高。數據於10月15日法說會前公布，印證AI需求續強，使台積電續為加權指數主要風向球。
items.summary_en: TSMC reported third-quarter consolidated revenue of NT$989.9 billion, a 6% sequential gain that beat its own guidance and set an all-time quarterly high. Released ahead of the Oct 15 earnings call, the print reinforces AI-driven demand strength and keeps the stock pivotal to the weighted index's direction.

items.title_zh: 台灣9月出口872.2億美元創新高、年增60.9%
items.title_en: Taiwan's September exports hit record US$87.2bn, up 60.9% YoY
items.summary_zh: 財政部公布9月出口872.2億美元，創歷年單月新高、年增60.9%，連35紅刷新最長紀錄。電子零組件與資通視聽產品合占出口80.5%，積體電路年增46.1%，確立AI需求為出口主引擎，第四季動能料延續。
items.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance reported September exports of US$87.22 billion, an all-time monthly high and a 60.9% annual jump that extended the record winning streak to 35 straight months. Electronics and ICT products made up 80.5% of shipments, with integrated-circuit exports up 46.1%, confirming AI demand as the dominant growth engine.

items.title_zh: 對美、對東協出口創高 反映AI供應鏈移轉
items.title_en: Exports to US and ASEAN surge to records on AI supply-chain shift
items.summary_zh: 9月台灣對美國出口274.6億美元、年增1.1倍，對東協出口188.8億美元、年增93.4%，雙雙刷新單月新高。顯示AI伺服器建置與供應鏈移轉加速，出口動能向外擴散，區域布局更趨多元。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's September exports to the United States jumped 106% YoY to US$27.46 billion, while shipments to ASEAN rose 93.4% to US$18.88 billion, both monthly records. The twin surges reflect accelerating AI-server build-outs and supply-chain relocation, broadening Taiwan's export strength beyond its core markets.

items.title_zh: 金管會核准玉山金股份轉換併購三商美邦人壽
items.title_en: FSC clears E.Sun Financial's share-swap takeover of Mercuries Life
items.summary_zh: 金管會核准玉山金以每0.2486股換發1股方式取得三商壽100%股權。金管會要求玉山金出具保戶權益不受影響聲明，並承諾員工全數留用、三年內勞動權益不變，推進今年金融業最大整併案之一。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved E.Sun Financial Holding's acquisition of 100% of Mercuries Life via a share swap of 0.2486 E.Sun shares per Mercuries Life share. Regulators required pledges that policyholder rights stay intact and that all insurer staff be retained for three years, advancing one of the year's largest financial-sector consolidations.

items.title_zh: 國銀放款月增1,341億元 個人放款成主力
items.title_en: Bank lending rises NT$134.1bn in a month, led by personal loans
items.summary_zh: 國銀放款餘額單月增加1,341億元，個人放款為成長主力。金管會指出，國內外股市熱絡帶動投資理財需求，推升相關借貸。數據顯示多頭市況下信用成長穩健，持續支撐金融業營運動能。
items.summary_en: Domestic banks' outstanding loans grew by NT$134.1 billion over the month, with personal lending the main driver as buoyant local and overseas equity markets spurred demand for investment- and wealth-related borrowing. The data point to resilient credit growth underpinning the financial sector against a strong market backdrop.

items.title_zh: 金管會擴大保險業「健康福祉事業」投資範疇
items.title_en: FSC widens insurers' "health and welfare" investment scope
items.summary_zh: 金管會發布令釋即日生效，取消投資對象須與保單業務連結的限制，服務不再限於保戶。長照顧問、輔助服務與智慧生活輔具納入範圍，非上市櫃標的最高可100%持股，引導壽險長期資金投入高齡化經濟。
items.summary_en: The FSC issued a ruling, effective immediately, letting insurers invest in health-and-welfare businesses without the prior requirement that the services link to their own policyholders. Long-term-care advisory, assistive-living and smart-aid ventures now qualify, and insurers may hold up to 100% of unlisted targets, channelling long-term capital into the aging-society economy.

items.title_zh: 因應高齡化 金管會將推法規鬆綁與保險定價放寬
items.title_en: FSC signals looser rules and pricing flexibility for aging-society insurance
items.summary_zh: 金管會透露，因應超高齡社會將推動法規鬆綁並放寬保險商品定價彈性，鼓勵保障型與長照型保單。政策方向盼使保險業自單純理賠角色延伸至事前預防與長照服務，為財富與退休規劃開拓新型商品線。
items.summary_en: Facing a super-aged society, the FSC said it will push regulatory easing and relax insurance-product pricing to encourage protection and long-term-care coverage. The direction aims to steer the industry from pure claims-payer toward prevention and elder-care services, opening new wealth- and retirement-planning product lines.
